item.title: Criteo Joins OpenAI Advertising Pilot in ChatGPT
item.description: The combination enables Criteo to support commerce-focused advertising across a wide range of categories and environments, including emerging discovery surfaces like conversational AI.

item.title: Dstillery, Keynes, & The Trade Desk Partner to Advance Agentic Advertising
item.description: As industry standards like the IAB Tech Lab's Agentic Advertising Initiative and AdCP establish common systems, DS 1 will unlock new integrations and capabilities for clients - at no additional cost or effort.

item.title: LiveRamp Unveils New AI Agents for End-to-End Marketing Workflows
item.description: The expansion empowers marketers to execute on their end-to-end marketing via agents — from audience building to measurement and media optimisation — with governed access to premium data, all from one central hub.

item.title: Smartly Integrates with Amazon DSP to Expand CTV Reach
item.description: Smartly’s integration with Amazon DSP unifies social and CTV campaigns, pairing intelligent creative with full-funnel activations and reporting across Amazon's premium streaming inventory.

item.title: Wix Partners with OpenAI to Launch Wix App in ChatGPT
item.description: Within ChatGPT, anyone can simply describe the website they want via text or voice and a fully functional, production-ready Wix Harmony website is generated instantly.

item.title: Discuss Introduces Real-Time AI Translation for Observers
item.description: By embedding AI directly into live translation and study execution, Discuss equips teams to conduct multilingual research at scale without the structural cost and delay historically associated with global qualitative work.

item.title: Entravision Acquires Playback Rewards’ Technology to Boost Loyalty Advertising
item.description: The Playback assets will be incorporated into Adwake’s Rewarded & Loyalty advertising roadmap, supporting faster product innovation and expanded campaign capabilities across mobile environments.

item.title: Onetag Announces Acquisition of Aryel
item.description: With this acquisition, Onetag has taken a step toward reshaping digital advertising, from fragmented transactions and poor user experience to a unified value exchange built on quality, intelligence, and outcomes.

item.title: Picsart Introduces New ‘Faceless’ Tools: Persona and Storyline
item.description: The AI platform is introducing a dual toolset, Persona and Storyline, specifically designed to address the two main challenges in AI content creation: scaling narratives and character consistency.

item.title: Typeface Launches Marketing Orchestration Engine
item.description: Looking ahead, Typeface is extending orchestration into Arc Loop, a closed-loop system where marketing performance feeds directly back into how AI operates.
